theme: European and global aviation stats: Eurocontrol, EASA, ACI airport passenger stats, IATA public figures, airport monthly traffic scrapers (Heathrow, Schiphol, ADP, Fraport, AENA)
queries_run: gh search repos "airport passenger statistics" --limit 30 --sort stars
gh search repos "eurostat air passenger" --limit 30 --sort stars
gh search repos "aena passenger" OR "schiphol traffic" OR "heathrow traffic" --limit 30 --sort stars
gh search repos "OpenSky Network" flight traffic dataset --limit 30 --sort stars
gh search repos "IATA" airport statistics --limit 30 --sort stars

candidates.name: euctrl-pru/daio
candidates.what_it_holds: Daily flight counts (departures, arrivals, internal, overflights, circular) for EUROCONTROL member states, e.g. columns flt_daio/flt_d/flt_a/flt_i/flt_o/flt_c, daily granularity from ~2019 (example date 2019-01-01) per country (Spain includes Canary Islands). Official EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit org repo.
candidates.why_useful: Country-level daily European air traffic (departures/arrivals) is a real-time-ish proxy for cross-border travel demand into ABNB's largest ex-US markets (Spain, France, Italy, UK, Germany) -- useful for nowcasting European nights/ADR ahead of guide dates (gap: international travel volume proxies).
candidates.size_hint: not stated; likely a few thousand rows (country x day)
candidates.last_activity: unknown, active org (2026 repos present in org)

candidates.name: euctrl-pru/OPDI (Open Performance Data Initiative)
candidates.what_it_holds: Python ETL pipeline (9 stages) pulling raw ADS-B state vectors from OpenSky Network S3, aircraft metadata, and OurAirports reference data; generates H3 geospatial reference grids; exports to parquet/CSV.gz on Azure Iceberg/S3. No committed processed datasets themselves; official EUROCONTROL org repo tied to opdi-portal (public data initiative).
candidates.why_useful: Method to reconstruct flight-level European air traffic (route, airport pairs) from raw ADS-B if a real point-in-time European travel-demand series is needed; heavier lift than a stored dataset but a credible, non-terms-of-service-violating pipeline.
candidates.size_hint: pipeline code only, no data committed (references a ~35GB external OSM extract not tracked)

candidates.name: euctrl-pru/airport-dashboard
candidates.what_it_holds: Dashboard application for airport performance monitoring, part of the official EUROCONTROL PRU org; likely consumes PRU data APIs rather than storing a standalone dataset (not independently verified - README not fetched due to budget).
candidates.why_useful: Could point to airport-level throughput metrics (delays, movements) that correlate with regional travel activity in Europe; needs closer inspection to confirm data vs. dashboard-only.

candidates.name: euctrl-pru/data-app_website
candidates.what_it_holds: Website/front-end for the official EUROCONTROL 'Data App' (dashboard at eurocontrol.int/dashboard) -- points to EUROCONTROL's own hosted traffic/statistics dashboards rather than storing data in-repo.
candidates.why_useful: Confirms EUROCONTROL's own public Data App (traffic counts, delay stats by state/airport) as an external source; not itself a dataset but documents the sanctioned public data surface for European air traffic, worth a manual pull if European travel-volume proxy is prioritized.

candidates.name: thomasdubdub/eurocontrol-data-archive
candidates.what_it_holds: Python framework (archive.py + 4 Jupyter notebooks) to load and visualize the EUROCONTROL R&D Data Archive (flight trajectories, e.g. 'short-haul flights over German upper airspace') as pandas/GeoPandas dataframes. No committed datasets -- wraps the external EUROCONTROL R&D archive (eurocontrol.int/dashboard/rnd-data-archive), which itself requires registration to access underlying flight data.
candidates.why_useful: Only third-party (non-EUROCONTROL-org) tool found with real stars (9) for EUROCONTROL data; marginal for ABNB nights/ADR forecasting since it is trajectory/airspace-level, not airport passenger counts, and requires external archive access.

notes: This theme surfaced very little committed data on GitHub. gh search repos on 'eurocontrol data', 'airport passenger statistics', 'eurostat air passenger', 'aena passenger'/'schiphol traffic'/'heathrow traffic' (OR combined), 'OpenSky Network flight traffic dataset', and 'IATA airport statistics' returned almost nothing relevant -- mostly student ML-clustering notebooks on the SFO Kaggle file (excluded per instructions) or unrelated FIR-boundary GeoJSON repos. The one substantive cluster found is the official EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit GitHub org (euctrl-pru), which was NOT surfaced by gh search repos keyword queries at all -- it was found only via the 'data-app_website' hit and then explored directly by org name. Within that org, daio (daily country-level flight counts) is the most concrete stored dataset; OPDI, airport-dashboard, and opdi-portal are pipeline/portal code pointing at OpenSky or EUROCONTROL's own systems rather than committed CSVs. No dedicated GitHub repos were found scraping/mirroring ACI (Airports Council International), IATA public monthly figures, or individual airport operators' (Heathrow, Schiphol/AENA/ADP/Fraport) monthly traffic PDFs/press releases -- these appear to be an underserved niche on GitHub; a manual pull directly from each airport's investor-relations 'traffic statistics' page (all publish monthly PDFs/XLS) would likely beat anything scraped from GitHub. WebSearch budget was exhausted session-wide (shared across all ~10 concurrent scout agents) after 3 queries, cutting short broader keyword coverage beyond gh search + WebFetch on specific repos. Recommend a follow-up scout with fresh WebSearch budget target queries: 'ACI Airports Council International traffic data github', 'AENA aeropuertos estadisticas github scraper', 'Heathrow Schiphol Fraport monthly traffic scraper github', 'IATA air passenger market analysis github dataset'.
